requirements: Provide text alternatives for meaningful images.
Use sufficient text and interface contrast.
Do not communicate information through color alone.
Provide appropriate captions and alternatives for media.
Ensure interactive targets meet applicable requirements.
Provide programmatically determinable names and roles.

healthcare_specific_considerations: Use understandable language for patient-facing content.
Do not assume users are medically knowledgeable.
Provide alternatives to complex digital interactions where supported.
Make critical instructions easy to locate.
Ensure sensitive forms clearly communicate purpose and next steps.
validation: Testing with representative users where feasible
rules: Automated tools alone cannot establish full accessibility.
Confirm applicable legal and contractual accessibility obligations.
Do not claim WCAG conformance without appropriate evaluation.
